name: The 2 A.M. Call
why_it_works: Everyone has had a phone call that split life into before and after. A late-night time stamp drops the viewer into that fear instantly. The brand doesn't play hero by promising outcomes; it plays the calm first step, which is what a scared person actually wants to buy.

hook.pattern: A clock time and 'unknown number' on a glowing phone. Dread first, words second.
examples: 2:14 a.m. Unknown number. She picked up.

variables.name: call_time
variables.description: The time of the call, as shown on a phone

variables.name: caller_situation
variables.description: A composite, anonymized line describing their crisis, starting with a capital letter, spoken, 10 words or fewer
variables.example: My son crashed and the other driver blames him

variables.name: first_step
variables.description: The calm, concrete first step you took, spoken, 8 words or fewer
variables.example: told her what not to say before morning

variables.name: morning_after
variables.description: How things felt the next morning, no outcome claims, spoken, 9 words or fewer
variables.example: she had a plan and a name to call

variables.name: cta_line
variables.description: How to reach you, plainly, starting with a capital letter, 6 words or fewer

beats.purpose: hook: the time on the phone

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 close-up of a phone lighting up on a dark nightstand showing an incoming call at {{call_time}}, cold blue screen glow, everything else in shadow
Vertical photo of an anonymous person sitting at a dim kitchen table, phone to ear, head down, single overhead pendant light, face in shadow
Vertical photo of a desk at {{brand}} at night, a single lamp on, a notepad with a checklist, coffee cup, calm and orderly
Slow push-in through a window as sunrise light fills an ordinary kitchen, steam from a mug, calm, vertical 9:16

craft.technique: Inciting call, then the first calm step
craft.notes: Keep the caller anonymous and lit in shadow. The turn is relief, not victory: a plan, not a verdict. Use silence and dark frames in the first half, then let sunrise light do the emotional work in the clip.

do_not: Promise or hint at a case result, payout or approval
Use a real client's story without written consent
Make it a fear-sell with sirens and crash footage
compliance: Law firms: no guarantees or implications of outcome; label the story 'Dramatization. Composite story.' on screen; follow your state bar's advertising rules, including required disclaimers and attorney responsibility statements
Law firms: do not imply a specialist certification you do not hold
Insurance, mortgage and financial: no promise of approval, coverage, savings or returns; show your license or NMLS number where required
Do not depict a real crash, injury or identifiable person
